name: BB_Z
exact_formula: BB_Z = (close_adj - MA20)/SD20; MA20/SD20 = 20-trading-day rolling mean/std of close_adj (ddof=1), identical to frozen BB(20,2) construction; evaluated at signal_date close
primary_test: daily cross-sectional Spearman IC of predictor vs final simple_return_pct among same-day signals (>=5); mean IC, Newey-West mean t, block bootstrap CI; BH FDR m=17
gate: A BH q<.05; B |mean daily IC|>=0.03; C pairwise rank accuracy>=53%; D TopK(K=3) selection lift>=+0.5pp; E block-bootstrap K3 lift 95% CI>0; F 2020/2021/2022 at least 2/3 same direction and no clearly-reverse year

name: BB_LOWER_DISTANCE
exact_formula: BB_LOWER_DISTANCE = close_adj / (MA20 - 2*SD20) - 1 (distance above BB lower, negative = deeper oversold)

name: STOCK_RV20
exact_formula: STOCK_RV20 = std of daily raw returns over past 20 trading days (ddof=1), evaluated at T

name: ATR20_PCT
exact_formula: ATR20_PCT = ATR20/close; TR = max(high-low, |high-pre_close|, |low-pre_close|); ATR20 = 20-trading-day mean of TR

name: AMOUNT
exact_formula: AMOUNT = log(amount) at T (T-day turnover in raw data unit, log scale; monotonic transform does not affect rank IC)

name: AMOUNT_RATIO20
exact_formula: AMOUNT_RATIO20 = amount / MA20(amount) (T-day turnover vs its own 20d mean)

name: CLOSE_LOCATION
exact_formula: CLOSE_LOCATION = (close-low)/(high-low), NaN if high==low (close near day high = weak stabilization hypothesis)

name: REL_RET1
exact_formula: REL_RET1 = RET1 - AllA_EW_ret1; AllA_EW = equal-weight index of PIT-eligible non-ST A-shares; AllA_EW_retk = AllA_EW_level[t]/AllA_EW_level[t-k]-1
